decision: User-approved 53-second trailer, October 16. The accepted review MP4 and poster were promoted byte-for-byte to the tracked public assets.
Use step-by-step order. Start with Auto/presets; introduce custom import as optional next step. Full-palette controls precede 1-bit controls. Inspect and compare results at the end.

Alternate wall counts 1,2,1,2,1,2,1,2,1; closing wall has 2. Both devices use the same count, with disjoint artwork on every paired screen. Comparison is an intentional matched-source exception, not an app wall.
Actual app captures only, including current compact phone settings. Screenshots retain full rectangular bounds. Focus crops show actual controls, never reconstructed UI.
Dedicated palette import scene is now authorized. Show a real Lospec import using archived endpoint data, review, save and applied palette. Do not imply import is required.
Show Max colors, Cleanup, full-palette dithering/strength, PNG Keep opacity, output count, Reuse colors and preview zoom/compare. Do not imply Cleanup always improves details or Keep works in GIF.
Keep 1-bit palette and threshold/pattern demonstrations. Black & White preset in Palette mode is distinct from structural 1-bit styles.
Final comparison retains identical Town crop/scaling and actual PICO-8 max 8 Cleanup On / Mono Solid outputs. No retouching or invented algorithm claims.

Preserve exact brand slogan, website and repository URLs. No voiceover or on-screen music credit. Review arrangement repeats the supplied soundtrack with a crossfade; provenance/credits retain required attribution.
